name: attachment-scanner
description: ClamAV scan endpoint for support attachments (SUPPORT_ATTACHMENT_SCAN_URL)
//: type=commonjs is deliberate and load-bearing. The repo root sets type=module, and Node resolves module type from the nearest package.json — so without this, `node services/attachment-scanner/server.js` fails on require(). In the container it happens to work because /app has no package.json, but relying on an absent file is not a contract.
